theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the strongest challenger to the crowded leader and is trend-eligible with a non-crowded crowding z (0.64) and durability above the leader's. The rotation margin (0.417) is comfortable but not extreme, and the detector's one validated edge (trend gate) supports staying with an eligible trend theme while the leader itself is crowded. This is a relative-preference lean, not a momentum forecast.
evidence: gate_helps=true — absolute-trend discipline validated on this market
theses.dissent: AI Infrastructure shares the SMH ETF proxy with the crowded leader and semis complex, so the 'non-crowded' read is partly an artifact of theme definition, not true diversification; a semis-wide pullback hits both.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 50-day average while the S&P 500 holds above its own 50-day average within the 20-day horizon

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the highest-ranked non-SMH trend theme (rank 4, eligible, hurst=trend) with the best breadth (0.5) in the top ranks, suggesting the trend is not single-name dependent. It uses a distinct proxy (CIBR), so it is not the same exposure as the crowded semis cluster. The crowding z of 1.93 is a size-down caution, not a fade signal.
theses.dissent: Crowding is elevated and the theme is slow-moving software exposure; if the AI-hardware narrative rolls over broadly, cybersecurity may be sold alongside it regardless of its own trend-health as a risk-reduction target.

falsifier.text: CIBR closes below its 50-day average within the 20-day horizon

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the only eligible non-tech, non-miners trend theme in the top of the ranks (rank 7, hurst=trend, not crowded) and offers a distinct XLE proxy from the crowded SMH/tech cluster. The absolute-trend gate supports holding an eligible trend theme, and its non-crowded texture means no size-down caution applies.
theses.dissent: Breadth is very thin (0.045), suggesting the trend rests on a narrow set of names, and energy is a commodity-beta theme vulnerable to a rapid mean-reversion if the macro backdrop shifts.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 50-day average within the 30-day horizon
